title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A test that counts instead of timing
summary: Yesterday's release pinned a linear pass with a stopwatch, which reads ten times higher on a busy machine. It is now pinned by counting array scans, which the machine load does not move.

highlights.title: No behaviour change, one fewer flaky guard
highlights.description: The timing version failed at 60 ms against a 50 ms bound on a loaded machine while the work itself was fine. The counting version passes there and still catches the quadratic version.

sections.heading: Internal
bullets: The growth ratio was tried first and rejected on measurement: it swung from 1.7 to 11.9 on a loaded machine.
The last asynchronous stopwatch assertion in the suite is gone.
